message.content:
The image is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large gold letters at the top. Below the title, the bold black text "HUJAN FULUS DIRGANTARA" dominates the center. Smaller text underneath reads "PT Dirgantara Indonesia menebar fulus ratusan miliar rupiah untuk puluhan jenderal dan perwira menengah di Kementerian Pertahanan dan Tentara Nasional Indonesia. Siapa yang kecipratan?". In the upper corners, additional text reads "PRO-KONTRA LEMBAGA PENGELOLA INVESTASI" and "DI BALIK PENANGKAPAN PENENTANG OMNIBUS".

The illustration shows four soldiers in the foreground wearing light brown uniforms, vests, and helmets with goggles. One soldier on the left salutes with a camera hanging from his neck. Another on the right holds a rifle. They are surrounded by numerous banknotes falling from several helicopters above. The background features yellow-toned buildings and the tail of a large aircraft. The scene is bathed in an orange and yellow light. A red bar runs vertically along the left edge. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner with the date "26 OKTOBER-1 NOVEMBER 2020".
